scope:
Deduplicate the two valid existing-volume inputs against frozen R37.

For the same signed SellV3 transaction, a different existing volume account is
a different input. Full before maps are compared when available. Older suites
only store post-state: the four volume metrics are unchanged by SellV3, as
separately established by the static path and both witnesses; those values can
exclude equality but never create an exact full-state duplicate claim.
policy: Suppress any possible prior metric match; admit only when every same-transaction record is excluded by bound account state. Full canonical before hashes keep the two witness states distinct.
